steps_raw.title: Prepare PCR master mix.
steps_raw.instruction: --> volumes are per reaction --> x (number of strains + 2) undetermined, MQ undetermined, 10 µM forward primer undetermined, 10 µM reverse primer undetermined, Phire Plant Direct PCR Master Mix

steps_raw.title: Aliquot into PCR tubes and add 0.5 µL of strains you wish to genotype.
steps_raw.instruction: --> Include appropriate positive (if available) and negative controls. --> Include WT or knockout strain you used for transformation as a template in one of the reactions.

steps_raw.title: Passage genotype+ strains.
steps_raw.instruction: --> 1:100 or 1:50 dilution into 10 mL fresh medium is a good place to start.
